detail.longDescription: I follow several Chinese tech magazines and bloggers. * Doing so is instructive and fascinating, whether it’s seeing topics discussed that are also present in the imperial West, or running into entirely different topics. Here it may not be so different from what you read in the western world, but take these headlines from https:// juejin.cn for a taste of the mood in web development. (The “high-value female” headline, if it catches your eye, seems to have been translated poorly, not constitute a sexist piece.) AI is eating its way inwards. * Unfortunately via Chrome, which seems to be the only browser that gets auto-translation right? # webdev # china # west # ai
